key_insight: The paper develops an FE2 multiscale framework that couples a shear-deformable beam model at the macro scale with a truss-based periodic lattice microstructure at the RVE scale.
engineering_relevance: This enables efficient and accurate analysis of load-bearing lattice beams in additive-manufactured structures while retaining sensitivity to microstructural architecture.
method: Truss-based microscopic RVE with periodic displacement boundary conditions
Constraint equations and local correction factors to remove rigid-body modes and reduce boundary artifacts
evidence_signal: The approach is validated on 2D and 3D lattice structures under geometric/material linear and nonlinear cases, showing RVE-length-independent homogenized stress resultants and material matrices with good agreement to reference models.
watch_item: The framework relies on carefully designed RVE constraints and correction factors, so implementation details and boundary handling may affect robustness for new lattice geometries.
paper_title: An FE2 model for shear-deformable beams considering periodic lattice-like truss mesostructures
